name: Frostsaber E'ko
label: Quest
description: Frostsaber E'ko: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: In Winterspring, you will fight great cats called frostsabers. These beasts possess incredible speed an' cunning. If you wish ta gain the speed a' da frostsaber, bring me da E'ko you find from dem.
Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mau'ari can derive da juju for friend... Use da Cache of Mau'ari to cast dis upon yourself or your allies.
